messages:
harper-logistics: Heads-up: AWB 999-1010101 (H100 batch) flagged at FRA. Broker connector timeout + manifest checksum error. Carrier says manual broker reconcile will add ~18-26h. We have 6 priority units that could be airlifted; need decision.
euro-forwarder-ops: Confirmed. Our EDI connector to the broker returned intermittent timeouts and a checksum mismatch on the manifest payload. They're doing manual reconciliation; ETA ~20h. We can provision a conditional airlift for 6 units FRA->LHR with 24h SLA if approved by 17:00 CET.
harper-logistics: Any customs paperwork gaps or HS/COO issues this time?
euro-forwarder-ops: Paperwork passed basic validation but customs flagged a random thermal inspection on 4 units. Depot wants high-res photos + serial reconciliation before final release.
marta-procurement: If manual hold >24h, we should greenlight the conditional airlift. Ballpark uplift for 6 H100s?
euro-forwarder-ops: Ballpark +€68k for next-day FRA->LHR (air uplift + brokerage + fuel surcharge). We can do split AWBs and keep a single warranty chain by serial. Need go-ahead by 17:00 CET to lock aircraft slots.
liam-ops: Which pools are affected? Sam, what's the infra impact if those 6 are delayed 24-48h?
sam-sre: Those 6 feed two EU-west burst pools and one enterprise install. A 24h delay will increase tail latency ~22% during peak; 48h will likely push one customer install. Canary scaling mitigations ready but not a full substitute for capacity.
harper-logistics: Important: vendor must confirm that RMA/DOA flows remain unified across split AWBs and that depot photo attestation is legally admissible for insurance claims.
euro-forwarder-ops: Confirmed. RMA follows serials; we'll attach one RMA reference across split AWBs. We'll also obtain a signed depot attestation confirming photos are official evidence.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-7740 linked to AWB 999-1010101. Status: awaiting depot photos and signed attestation.
harper-logistics: Uploading serials and photo index to the RMA now: `serials: [H100-LM3001,H100-LM3002,H100-LM3003,H100-LM3004,H100-LM3005,H100-LM3006]`
marta-procurement: I'll provisionally approve the €68k uplift pending partner credit-back confirmation. If forwarder partner owns the connector outage we should push for a partial credit.
euro-forwarder-ops: Escalated to partner ops. They acknowledged the connector fault and initiated a surcharge dispute/credit-back request. They can't guarantee outcome but prioritized our uplift claim. ETA for response ~3h.
liam-ops: Ops/legal: add explicit clause in RMA notes that depot-signed photo attestations and the forwarder's signed manifest are acceptable for warranty/insurance settlement.
harper-logistics: Noted and added to RMA-7740 comments. Plan: hold for partner credit decision until 17:00 CET. If waiver denied, execute conditional airlift. Sam, please spin canary mitigations now.
sam-sre: Canary in place. Pre-warming smaller instances, bumping autoscale thresholds, and routing non-critical inference to US pools as fallback. Policy flip done; monitor dashboards for the next 2h.
harper-logistics: Thanks everyone. @euro-forwarder-ops please prioritize depot photos and the signed manifest attestation. Also confirm whether the broker will accept our checksum-corrected manifest copy once manual reconcile completes.
